appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the interface should adapt to your display preferences.

step1.title: Step 1: Scan QR Code
step1.description: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)

step2.title: Step 2: Verify Setup
step2.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app to confirm setup.

step3.title: Step 3: Save Recovery Codes
step3.warning: Save these codes somewhere safe. You won't be able to see them again. Each code can only be used once.

done.title: Two-Factor Authentication Enabled
done.description: Your account is now protected with two-factor authentication.

disable.title: Confirm Disable 2FA
disable.description: Enter your 6-digit authenticator code to confirm disabling two-factor authentication.

regenerate.title: Regenerate Recovery Codes
regenerate.description: Enter your 6-digit authenticator code to generate new recovery codes. Your existing codes will be invalidated.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage account password and two-factor authentication.

password.description: Keep your password strong and unique for this account.
password.hint: You will use the new password next sign-in.
password.error: Failed to update password. Please try again.

recoveryCodes.title: Tellara MFA Recovery Codes
recoveryCodes.saveHint: Save these codes in a secure location.
recoveryCodes.onceHint: Each code can only be used once.
